# Implementation Plan: Enhanced Agent Metrics System

<!-- Generated by Spec-Kit /speckit.plan | Session: a0048076-0ae1-42e8-b25c-9d53f1b17c55 | Date: 2026-01-26 -->

**Branch**: `001-agent-metrics-enhancement` | **Date**: 2026-01-26 | **Spec**: [spec.md](./spec.md)
**Input**: Feature specification from `/specs/001-agent-metrics-enhancement/spec.md`

## Summary

Enhance the existing PowerShell-based agent metrics system to:
1. Capture AI model identifiers (Opus, Sonnet, Haiku) for every agent invocation
2. Extend metrics tracking to all 7 Spec-Kit phases (not just implement)
3. Add cost distribution analysis by model using relative pricing weights
4. Implement trend analysis across archived sessions
5. Support CSV/JSON export for external tool integration

The existing `agent-metrics.ps1` script provides a solid foundation with Init/Record/Report/Reset actions. This enhancement extends the schema, adds new actions (Trends, Compare, Cumulative, Export), and integrates metrics into all Spec-Kit commands.

## Technical Context

**Language/Version**: PowerShell 5.1+ (Windows), PowerShell Core 7+ (cross-platform)
**Primary Dependencies**: PowerShell native cmdlets only (no external modules required)
**Storage**: JSON files in `.specify/metrics/` directory (existing pattern preserved)
**Testing**: Pester 5.x for PowerShell unit tests
**Target Platform**: Windows 10/11 (primary), WSL/macOS/Linux (PowerShell Core)
**Project Type**: Single script with supporting utilities (extends existing pattern)
**Performance Goals**: Report generation <2 seconds with 100+ invocations per session (SC-006)
**Constraints**: No external dependencies; must work in Claude Code environment
**Scale/Scope**: 10+ archived sessions for trend analysis; 100+ invocations per session

## Phase 0: Research Summary

Research completed and documented in [research.md](./research.md).

### Key Decisions

| Topic | Decision | Rationale |
|-------|----------|-----------|
| **Model cost weights** | Relative multipliers (1:3:5 for Haiku:Sonnet:Opus) | Stable ratios, easy percentage calculation |
| **Parallel detection** | Hybrid approach (explicit markers + timestamp overlap) | Captures intent and validates actual execution |
| **Test framework** | Pester 5.x with TestDrive | Native PowerShell, file isolation, block-scoped mocks |
| **Settings storage** | JSON in `.specify/metrics/settings.json` | Consistent with existing patterns |
| **Export format** | CSV with standardized columns | Spreadsheet compatibility for FR-006 |

### Schema Changes (v2.0.0)

New fields added to invocation:
- `model`: AI model identifier (opus/sonnet/haiku)
- `phase`: Spec-Kit phase name
- `category`: Task category (implementation/testing/review/planning/analysis)
- `invocationStartTime`, `invocationEndTime`: For parallel detection
- `isParallel`, `parallelGroupId`, `groupSize`: Parallelization tracking

New session-level aggregates:
- `models`: Per-model statistics with cost weights
- `categories`: Per-category token usage
- `parallelGroups`: Parallel execution metrics

### New Actions

| Action | Purpose | FR Coverage |
|--------|---------|-------------|
| `Trends` | Analyze patterns across archived sessions | FR-005, FR-015 |
| `Compare` | Side-by-side session comparison | FR-011 |
| `Cumulative` | Cross-phase feature-level report | FR-017 |
| `Export` | CSV/JSON export for external tools | FR-006 |
